No B/C persistent-collapse subtype classifier is invented or refit.
No numeric magnitude/displacement mapping is invented after the blind boundary.
Full brain may change interpretation/confidence only where legally served inputs support the concept; it cannot retune frozen reveal medians or family/state rules.
Predictions must be persisted, hashed and committed before any heldout price reveal.
